name: chatlog-memory
description: Inject a bounded experience-memory index at session startup and recall accepted cards on demand.

interface.shortDescription: Recall accepted experience only when it applies.
interface.longDescription: Chatlog Memory adds a deterministic startup routing index and bounded, snapshot-pinned recall without loading historical evidence into every prompt.
defaultPrompt: Show the active memory routing index.
Recall a memory that applies to this task.
